stop: Stop after the decide canary plus main grid: they give table T4 (decision metrics per probe policy on T1) and decide whether decision-EVOI beats fixed/EIG/EPIG per probe-second (docs/board/decision.md).
_doc: Role decision. Task cfcap/decide/task.py:TASK via --task-spec: nuisance_post SMC on v2 (same episodes as nuis-main with --seed 1909), 64 draws pushed through T1 capability (rho_dec = rho_abs / nominal healthy rho_ref) for children + 10 merges, plus per-draw predictions of clamp / tug / moddiff and one diagnostic split per child. Output decide_eps/*.pkl per unit; the policy evaluation is offline on CPU (scripts/decide_t1_eval.py). unit_s are ESTIMATES: nuisance's per-episode SMC estimate (pair 20 s / square 40 s / 2x3 70 s on a 3090) x 1.6 for the probe and label sims; the canary measures it (unit sidecar meta.smc_s_mean, probe_s_mean). Inputs: the stage as every cfcap job.

groups.name: decide-canary
groups.pilot: ESTIMATE (nuisance canary basis); local 4070 smoke of the task: /tmp/decide_smoke (2 pair episodes, 64 particles, 16 draws) -> docs/board/decision.md
groups.purpose: Canary for the T1 decision-episode task on a rented 3090: one unit per parent shape, measuring seconds per episode for SMC, probe predictions and labels.

groups.name: decide-main
groups.pilot: ESTIMATE: 48 units (3 shapes x 16 units x 8 episodes = 384 episodes), mean ~110 s/episode incl. probes -> ~900 s/unit; replace by the canary's measured unit wall
groups.purpose: T1 decision episodes with posterior draws and probe predictions for table T4: unsafe-commit, useful-commit, abstention, regret and probe time per policy (fixed v2, random, EIG, EPIG, EVOI, always split).
